findings.field_extraction_cross_check: ingestion/campo-pequeno/discovery.mjs's extractCampoPequenoEventFacts() reproduces, field-for-field, the values already mechanically verified by research/source-investigations/campo-pequeno-lisbon-01/evidence/offline-proof.mjs and recorded in offline-proof-output.txt for all 4 sampled events, including the two distinct 'Sessões' free-text time-format patterns (A: 3/4 events; B: 1/4, megadeth) and the mechanically-confirmed Gregorian weekday for every sampled date.
findings.entity_decoding: Unlike the 'date'/'location' divs (plain literal UTF-8 characters), the 'Sessões' tab-pane text encodes accented Portuguese characters as named HTML entities (e.g. 'Início de espetáculo'). ingestion/campo-pequeno/discovery.mjs decodes the same small, fixed set of named entities evidence/offline-proof.mjs's own ENTITY_MAP already proved sufficient, before pattern-matching the time text — never a general-purpose HTML-entity library.
findings.source_record_id: PROVEN per investigation.json's field_assessment.source_record_id — the site's own <link rel="canonical"> tag (corroborated by its sitemap and an empirical cross-fetch) declares the short /pt/{slug} form as this event's stable identifying path. ingestion/campo-pequeno/observation-adapter.mjs derives source_record_id ONLY from that canonical event_url shape, never from the agenda-relative /pt/agenda/{slug} href form or any third-party ticketing URL.
findings.timezone: No timezone/UTC offset is stated anywhere in the retained evidence for any date/time field. certainty is FLOATING_LOCAL when both the calendar date and a Sessões time_text are mechanically known (3 of the 4 sampled events additionally expose a doors/start time, matching field_assessment.time.state = PARTIAL), DATE_ONLY when only the calendar date is known.
findings.cancellation: The source has no structured status/cancelled field (collector_assessment.blockers). The one sampled cancelled event (brandi-carlile---cancelado) signals cancellation only via free text: '- cancelado' appended to its own <h1> title, and 'Evento Cancelado' inside its own Sessões tab-pane text. is_cancelled is derived honestly from either signal and is NEVER used to drop the event from ingestion/campo-pequeno/observation-adapter.mjs's toObservation() output — the event remains a genuine Observation, with source_fields.is_cancelled = true and an honest description, exactly mirroring how the source itself still lists it on its own live public agenda.
